source: https://sts2.wiki/enemies/（社区 wiki，**不是权威**；权威是游戏本身）
note: 每条都是假设。判决要靠 verify --predict-enemy 和实录 trace。

axebot.name: axebot
axebot.pattern: Chooses randomly from One-Two, Sharpen, and Hammer Uppercut (allowed options equally likely). Cannot Sharpen twice in a row. Cannot use One-Two or Hammer Uppercut more than twice in a row. Summoned Axebots (from Stock) immediately start with Boot Up, then resume choosing random moves.

bowlbug-nectar.name: bowlbug (nectar)
bowlbug-nectar.pattern: Starts with Thrash -> Buff. Then uses Thrash every turn.

bowlbug-rock.name: bowlbug (rock)
bowlbug-rock.pattern: Uses Headbutt every turn. If fully blocked, becomes stunned for a turn before resuming Headbutt.

bowlbug-silk.name: bowlbug (silk)
bowlbug-silk.pattern: Alternates between Toxic Spit and Thrash.

bygone-effigy.name: bygone effigy
bygone-effigy.pattern: Starts with Sleep -> Wake -> Slash. Then uses Slash every turn after.

calcified-cultist.name: calcified cultist
calcified-cultist.pattern: Starts with Incantation. Then uses Dark Strike every turn after.

ceremonial-beast.name: ceremonial beast
ceremonial-beast.pattern: Starts with Stamp. Then uses Plow every turn until it is stunned. After being stunned, cycles through Beast Cry -> Stomp -> Crush.

chomper.name: chomper
chomper.pattern: First Chomper starts with Clamp, second with Screech. Then continue cycling through Clamp -> Screech.

corpse-slug.name: corpse slug
corpse-slug.pattern: First Corpse Slug picks its first move randomly. Each subsequent Corpse Slug starts with the next move in the cycle. Cycle through Whip Slap -> Glomp -> Gloop

crusher.name: crusher
crusher.pattern: Cycles through Thrash -> Enlarging Strike -> Bug Sting -> Adapt -> Guarded Strike.

cubex-construct.name: cubex construct
cubex-construct.pattern: Cycles through Charge Up -> Repeater Blast - > Repeater Blast -> Expel Blast -> Submerge.

damp-cultist.name: damp cultist
damp-cultist.pattern: Starts with Incantation. Then uses Dark Strike every turn after.

decimillipede-3-segments.name: decimillipede (3 segments)
decimillipede-3-segments.pattern: First segment starts with a random move, second segment starts with the next move in the cycle Writhe -> Bulk -> Constrict, and third segment starts with the next move after that. Cycles through Writhe -> Constrict -> Bulk. When killed, spends one turn dead and then one turn reviving with 25 HP. After reviving, continues the regular attack cycle from a random starting move.

devoted-sculptor.name: devoted sculptor
devoted-sculptor.pattern: Starts with Forbidden Incantation, then uses Savage every turn.

door.name: door
door.pattern: Cycles through Dramatic Open -> Door Slam -> Enforce. On death, becomes Doormaker.

entomancer.name: entomancer

moves.name: Pheromone Spit
moves.effect: If less than 3 Personal Hive: Gain 1 Personal Hive and 1 Strength / If at 3 Personal Hive: Gain 2 Strength

entomancer.pattern: Cycles through Bees -> Spear -> Pheromone Spit. After reaching 3 stacks of Personal Hive, switches to gaining 2 strength when using Pheromone Spit.

exoskeleton.name: exoskeleton
exoskeleton.pattern: First Exoskeleton starts with Skitter, second starts with Mandible, third starts with Enrage (and fourth starts randomly with Skitter or Mandible, if present). After Skitter always uses Mandible. After Mandible always uses Enrage. After Enrage chooses randomly between Skitter and Mandible.

fabricator.name: fabricator

moves.name: Fabricate
moves.effect: Summons 1 Defensive Bot / Summons 1 Aggro Bot

fabricator.pattern: When # allies (not counting self) is 2 or fewer, picks randomly between Fabricate and Fabricating Strike (equally likely). When # allies (not counting self) is 3 or more, always uses Disintegrate.

flail-knight.name: flail knight
flail-knight.pattern: Starts with Ram. Then chooses randomly between War Chant, Flail, and Ram (allowed options equally likely). Flail and Ram cannot be used more than twice in a row. War Chant cannot be used twice in a row.

flyconid.name: flyconid
flyconid.pattern: Starts randomly with Frail Spores or Smash (equal probability). Then picks move randomly (equal probability for allowed moves). Cannot use any move twice in a row. Vulnerable Spores has a 3 turn cooldown after use, and Frail Spores has a 2 turn cooldown after use. Exception: If at any point it uses Vuln Spores -> Frail Spores -> Smash, then it will have no allowed moves and default to Vulnerable Spores.

fogmog.name: fogmog
fogmog.pattern: Starts with Illusion -> Swipe. When using Swipe after a non-Swipe move, follows up with 40% chance to Swipe and 60% chance to Headbutt. After using Swipe for second time in a row, always follows with Headbutt. After Headbutt, always uses Swipe.

fossil-stalker.name: fossil stalker
fossil-stalker.pattern: Starts with Latch. Then chooses randomly between allowed options of Tackle, Latch, and Lash (allowed options equally likely). Moves cannot be used more than twice in a row.

frog-knight.name: frog knight
frog-knight.pattern: Cycles through Tongue Lash -> Strike Down Evil -> For the Queen. After For the Queen, if below half HP and Beetle Charge has not been used, then uses Beetle Charge before starting the cycle over.

fuzzy-wurm-crawler.name: fuzzy wurm crawler
fuzzy-wurm-crawler.pattern: Starts with Acid Goop. Then cycles through Inhale -> Acid Goop -> Acid Goop.

globe-head.name: globe head
globe-head.pattern: Cycles through Shocking Slap -> Thunder Strike -> Galvanic Burst.

gremlin-merc.name: gremlin merc
gremlin-merc.pattern: Cycles through Gimme -> Double Smash -> Hehe.

haunted-ship.name: haunted ship

moves.name: Haunt
moves.effect: Apply 2 Weak / Apply 2 Frail / Apply 2 Vulnerable

haunted-ship.pattern: Starts with Ramming Speed -> Haunt. Then picks randomly between Ramming Speed, Swipe, and Stomp (allowed options equally likely). Cannot use same move twice in a row.

hunter-killer.name: hunter killer
hunter-killer.pattern: Starts with Tenderizing Goop. Then chooses randomly between Bite and Puncture each turn. Bite cannot be used twice in a row. Puncture cannot be used more than twice in a row.

infested-prism.name: infested prism
infested-prism.pattern: Cycles through Jab -> Radiate -> Whirlwind -> Pulsate

inklet.name: inklet
inklet.pattern: Front and back Inklet start with Jab. Middle Inklet starts with Whirlwind. Alternates between Jab -> Whirlwind or Piercing Gaze (chosen randomly, equally likely).

kin-follower-minion.name: kin follower (minion)
kin-follower-minion.pattern: Cycles through Quick Slash -> Boomerang -> Power Dance.

kin-priest.name: kin priest
kin-priest.pattern: Cycles through Orb of Frailty -> Orb of Weakness -> Beam -> Ritual.

knowledge-demon.name: knowledge demon

moves.name: Curse of Knowledge
moves.effect: Player must choose one of two debuffs: / 1st choice: Disentegration 6 or Mind Rot / 2nd choice: Disentegration 7 or Sloth / 3rd Choice: Disentegration 8 or Waste Away

knowledge-demon.pattern: Cycles through Curse of Knowledge -> Slap -> Knowledge Overwhelming -> Ponder until Curse of Knowledge has been used 3 times. Then cycles through Slap -> Knowledge Overwhelming -> Ponder.

lagavulin-matriarch.name: lagavulin matriarch

moves.name: Soul Siphon
moves.effect: Apply -2 Strength / Apply -2 Dexterity / Gain 2 Strength

lagavulin-matriarch.pattern: Cycles through Slash -> Disembowel -> Slash 2 -> Soul Siphon.

leaf-slime-medium.name: leaf slime (medium)
leaf-slime-medium.pattern: Starts with Sticky Shot then alternates Clump Shot -> Sticky Shot.

leaf-slime-small.name: leaf slime (small)
leaf-slime-small.pattern: Starts randomly with Tackle or Goop. Then alternates between them.

living-fog.name: living fog

moves.name: Bloat
moves.effect: Summon N Gas Bombs / (N = # times Bloat has been used + 1, capped to 5)

living-fog.pattern: Starts with Advanced Gas. Then alternates between Bloat -> Super Gas Blast.

living-shield.name: living shield
living-shield.pattern: Uses Shield Slam every turn if Turret Operator is alive. Then uses Smash every turn once Turret Operator is dead.

louse-progenitor.name: louse progenitor
louse-progenitor.pattern: Cycles through Web Cannon -> Curl and Grow -> Pounce.

magi-knight.name: magi knight
magi-knight.pattern: Cycles through Power Shield -> Dampen -> Spear -> Prep -> Magic Bomb.

mawler.name: mawler
mawler.pattern: Starts with Claw. Then chooses randomly between Rip & Tear, Roar, and Claw (all allowed options equally likely). Roar can only be used once. Claw and Rip & Tear cannot be used twice in a row.

mecha-knight.name: mecha knight
mecha-knight.pattern: Starts with Charge. Then cycles through Flamethrower -> Windup -> Heavy Cleave.

myte.name: myte
myte.pattern: First Myte starts with Toxic, second Myte starts with Suck. Then continue cycling through Toxic -> Bite -> Suck.

nibbit.name: nibbit
nibbit.pattern: In the single Nibbit encounter, it cycles through Butt -> Slice -> Hiss. In the two Nibbits encounter, the front starts with Slice and the back starts with Hiss. They then continue the cycle Butt -> Slice -> Hiss.

moves.name: Noise
moves.effect: Add 1 Dazed to Discard / Add 1 Dazed to Draw

ovicopter.name: ovicopter
ovicopter.pattern: Starts with Lay Eggs -> Smash -> Tenderizer. If 3 allies are alive after Tenderizer, uses Nutritional Paste -> Smash -> Tenderizer. If less than 3 allies are alive after Tenderizer, uses Lay Eggs -> Smash -> Tenderizer.

owl-magistrate.name: owl magistrate
owl-magistrate.pattern: Cycles through Magistrate Scrutiny -> Peck Assault -> Judicial Flight -> Verdict.

phantasmal-gardener.name: phantasmal gardener
phantasmal-gardener.pattern: 1st one starts with Flail, 2nd with Bite, 3rd with Lash, and 4th with Enlarge. Then cycle through Bite -> Lash -> Flail -> Enlarge.

punch-construct.name: punch construct
punch-construct.pattern: Regular encounter: Cycles through Ready -> Strong Punch -> Fast Punch. Punch-Off event: First Punch Construct starts the cycle with Strong Punch (second starts with Ready like usual).

queen.name: queen
queen.pattern: Begins with Puppet Strings -> You Are Mine! Afterwards, while Amalgam is alive, always does Burn Bright For Me. If Amalgam dies and intent is Burn Bright For Me, intent is immediately replaced with Enrage. After Amalgam dies, cycles Off With Your Head -> Execution -> Enrage.

rocket.name: rocket
rocket.pattern: Cycles through Targeting Reticle -> Precision Beam -> Charge Up -> Laser -> Recharge.

ruby-raider-axe.name: ruby raider (axe)
ruby-raider-axe.pattern: Cycles through Swing -> Swing -> Big Swing.

ruby-raider-tracker.name: ruby raider (tracker)
ruby-raider-tracker.pattern: Starts with Track, then uses Hounds every turn.

scroll-of-biting.name: scroll of biting
scroll-of-biting.pattern: First scroll picks its first move randomly. Scrolls 2 and 3 starts with the next moves in the cycle Chomp -> Chew -> More Teeth. Scroll 4 (if present) starts with More Teeth. Then follows pattern Chomp -> More Teeth -> Chew, but after Chew picks randomly between Chomp and More Teeth and resumes pattern.

seapunk.name: seapunk
seapunk.pattern: Cycles through Sea Kick -> Spinning Kick -> Bubble Burp.

shrinker-beetle.name: shrinker beetle
shrinker-beetle.pattern: Starts with Shrinker. Then alternates Chomp -> Stomp.

skulking-colony.name: skulking colony
skulking-colony.pattern: Cycles through Smash -> Zoom -> Inertia -> Super Crab.

slimed-berserker.name: slimed berserker
slimed-berserker.pattern: Cycles through Vomit Ichor -> Furious Pummeling -> Leeching Hug -> Smother.

slithering-strangler.name: slithering strangler
slithering-strangler.pattern: Alternates between Constrict -> Thwack/Lash (chooses between Thwack and Lash at random, equally likely)

sludge-spinner.name: sludge spinner
sludge-spinner.pattern: Starts with Oil Spray. Then chooses randomly between all allowed moves each turn. Cannot use any move twice in a row.

slumbering-beetle.name: slumbering beetle
slumbering-beetle.pattern: Sleeps until it awakens. Then uses Roll Out every turn.

soul-fysh.name: soul fysh

moves.name: Beckon
moves.effect: Shuffle 1 Beckon into draw / Shuffle 1 Beckon into discard

soul-fysh.pattern: Cycles through Beckon -> De-Gas -> Gaze -> Fade -> Scream.

soul-nexus.name: soul nexus
soul-nexus.pattern: Starts with Soul Burn. Then picks randomly between Soul Burn, Maelstrom, and Drain Life (all allowed options equally likely). Cannot use the same move twice in a row.

spectral-knight.name: spectral knight
spectral-knight.pattern: Starts with Hex and then Soul Slash. Then chooses randomly between Soul Slash and Soul Flame (allowed options equally likely). Soul Slash cannot be used more than twice in a row. Soul Flame cannot be used twice in a row.

spiny-toad.name: spiny toad
spiny-toad.pattern: Cycles through Protruding Spikes -> Spike Explosion -> Tongue Lash.

stage-1.name: stage 1
stage-1.pattern: Cycles through Bite -> Skull Bash. When killed, revive next turn in stage 2.

stage-2.name: stage 2
stage-2.pattern: Cycles through Multi-Claw -> Pounce. When killed, revive next turn in stage 3.

stage-3.name: stage 3
stage-3.pattern: Cycles through Lacerate -> Big Pounce -> Burning Growl.

terror-eel.name: terror eel
terror-eel.pattern: Cycles between Crash -> Thrash until it gets stunned by reaching 75 HP. Then uses Terror before cycling Crash -> Thrash again.

the-insatiable.name: the insatiable

moves.name: Liquify Ground
moves.effect: Gain Sandpit 4 / Shuffle 3 Frantic Escapes into draw / Shuffle 3 Frantic Escapes into discard

the-insatiable.pattern: Starts with Liquify Ground. Afterwards, cycles through Thrash -> Lunging Bite -> Salivate -> Thrash.

the-lost.name: the lost
the-lost.pattern: Alternates between Debilitating Smog -> Eye Lasers

the-obscura.name: the obscura
the-obscura.pattern: Starts with Illusion. Then chooses randomly between Piercing Gaze, Wail, and Hardening Strike (allowed options equally likely). Cannot use any move twice in a row.

thieving-hopper.name: thieving hopper

moves.name: Thievery
moves.effect: Damage 17 (19) / Steal 1 card and gain Swipe / (Stolen card is taken from draw or discard pile. Chooses a random card with priorities: 1. non-imbued uncommon card, 2. non-imbued common, rare, or event card, 3. non-imbued basic or quest card, 4. imbued or ancient card, 5. curse or anything else) / (Warning: Game softlocks if Thieving Hopper cannot find a valid target to steal)

thieving-hopper.pattern: Always uses Thievery -> Flutter -> Hat Trick -> Nab -> Escape. If stunned before turn 5, resumes with the next intent in the pattern. If stunned on turn 5, tries to Escape again.

toadpole.name: toadpole
toadpole.pattern: Front Toadpole starts with Spiken. Non-front Toadpole(s) start with Whirl. Then continue following cycle Spike Spit -> Whirl -> Spiken (then repeat).

torch-head-amalgam.name: torch head amalgam
torch-head-amalgam.pattern: Begins with Tackle -> Tackle. Afterwards, cycles Soul Beam -> Weak Tackle -> Weak Tackle.

tunneler.name: tunneler
tunneler.pattern: Starts with Bite -> Burrow. While Burrowed, always uses Below. After being stunned, loses Burrowed and uses Bite -> Burrow.

twig-slime-m.name: twig slime (m)
twig-slime-m.pattern: Starts with Sticky Shot -> Clump Shot. Then chooses randomly each turn between Sticky Shot and Clump Shot (allowed options equally likely). Cannot use Sticky Shot twice in a row, and cannot use Clump shot more than twice in a row.

two-tailed-rat.name: two-tailed rat
two-tailed-rat.pattern: First Rat starts randomly with Scratch, Disesase Bite, or Screech. 2nd Rat has next move after it in the cycle Scratch -> Disease Bite -> Screech, and 3rd Rat has the next after that. A rat cannot Call for Backup until it has taken 2 turns. Each rat can only Call for Backup once. Only 1 rat can Call for Backup in any particular turn. Call for Backup can only be used 3 times total across all rats. If Call for Backup is not allowed for a rat, it picks randomly between Scratch, Disease Bite, and Screech (equal weight among allowed options). If Call for Backup is allowed for a rat, then it has a 75% chance to Call for Backup, and remaining 25% to pick randomly between Scratch, Disease Bite, and Screech (equal weight among allowed options). Screech has a 3 turn cooldown. Scratch and Disease Bite cannot be used twice in a row.

vantom.name: vantom
vantom.pattern: Cycles through Ink Blot -> Inky Lance -> Dismember -> Prepare.

vine-shambler.name: vine shambler
vine-shambler.pattern: Cycles through Swipe -> Grasping Vines -> Chomp.

waterfall-giant.name: waterfall giant

moves.name: Stomp
moves.effect: Damage 15 (16) / Apply 1 Weak / Gain 3 Steam Eruption

moves.name: Pressure Gun
moves.effect: Damage 20 (23) + 5*N / N = # of times this move was used / Gain 3 Steam Eruption

waterfall-giant.pattern: Cycles through Pressurize -> Stomp -> Ram -> Siphon -> Pressure Gun -> Pressure Up.

wriggler.name: wriggler

moves.name: Wriggle
moves.effect: Add 1 Infection to Discard / Gain 2 Strength

wriggler.pattern: If spawned from Phrog Parasite's death, starts stunned. Otherwise (or after stun), Wrigglers in positions 1 & 3 start with Nasty Bite and Wrigglers in positions 2 & 4 start with Wriggle. They then alternate between Nasty Bite -> Wriggle.
